scope: Prompt deletion delay and duplicate success notification; scoped shared Prompt/folder publication work and pending delete lifecycle.
head: 108f375bcd2c3e94c20d93dd619d641b6386b352

ownership.preserved: Unrelated dirty worktree changes including existing Prompt copy/AI detail hydration, root-folder move and .trash reader behavior. No commit, push, branch, PR, or subagent.
ownership.authority: Existing canonical-files runtime was inspected read-only; no schema, file format, authority marker or migration changes.

findings: Core already publishes canonical ordinary mutations inside a SQLite transaction; desktop IPC repeated publication and full legacy workspace export across Prompt and folder mutations.

Canonical publication copied unchanged Prompt bundles and replaced the whole Prompt directory. In-place publication now reuses verified unchanged bundles and CAS manifest entries, while changed/deleted bundles and complete catalog use the existing journal.

Delete confirmation lacked pending state and submission protection; the renderer service ignored a false IPC delete result. A delayed-delete fixture validates repeat-input behavior. The exact original user click sequence was not observed.

behavior.ordinaryMutations: Skip duplicate IPC publication/export only in existing canonical-files mode; preserve database-catalog workspace synchronization.
behavior.directInputs: Direct inserts, graph restore, IDB migration batch and explicit sync still publish explicitly.
behavior.publication: Retain byte-identical Prompt bundles; complete inventory/hash verification and SQLite/filesystem rollback remain. Initial publication and default standalone export generate complete directories.
behavior.delete: One request while pending; loading/disabled confirmation and cancel; one success toast on successful completion; error toast plus preserved selection/data/dialog and retry on rejection or false.
